answer: Builder take: score each seat like a Gitcoin Passport. One stamp is a zephyr, light and easy to fake; a nebula of independent stamps (aged repo, ENS name, BrightID, on-chain history) is costly to fake for 20 clones at once. Proposed: a seat counts only at score >= 20, each stamp worth 1-8 points, and a stamp claimed by two IDs is void for both, so a clone farm leaves a plume of shared stamps we can trace. Measured today: 50 seats; stamp scores unmeasured.
